ne4:1.4: assādaṃ ādīnavaṃ nissaraṇaṃ phalaṃ upāyaṃ āṇattiṃ.
ne4:1.5: “dhammaṃ vo bhikkhave desissāmi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevala paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsissāmī”ti.
ne4:24.1: tattha bhagavā ugghaṭitaññussa puggalassa nissaraṇaṃ deseti. vipañcitaññussa puggalassa ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇaṃ ca deseti. neyyassa puggalassa assādaṃ ca ādīnavaṃ ca nissaraṇaṃ ca deseti.
ne4:25.1: tattha catasso paṭipadā cattāro puggalā ca,
ne4:25.2: taṇhācarito mando satindriyena dukkhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya niyyāti satipaṭṭhānehi nissayehi,
ne4:25.3: taṇhācarito udattho samādhindriyena dukkhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya niyyāti jhānehi nissayehi,
ne4:25.4: diṭṭhicarito mando viriyindriyena sukhāya paṭipadāya dandhābhiññāya niyyāti sammappadhānehi nissayehi,
ne4:25.5: diṭṭhicarito udattho paññindriyena sukhāya paṭipadāya khippābhiññāya niyyāti saccehi nissayehi.
ne4:26.1: ubho taṇhācaritā, samathapubbaṅgamāya vipassanāya niyyanti rāgavirāgāya cetovimuttiyā,
ne4:26.2: ubho diṭṭhicaritā vipassanāpubbaṅgamena samathena niyyanti avijjāvirāgāya paññāvimuttiyā.
ne4:27.1: tattha ye samathapubbaṅgamāhi paṭipadāhi niyyanti, te nandiyā vaṭṭena nayena hātabbā. ye vipassanāpubbaṅgamāhi paṭipadāhi niyyanti, the sīhavikkīḷitena nayena hātabbā.
ne4:28.1: svāyaṃ hāro kattha sambhavati : yassa satthā vā dhammaṃ deseti aññataro vā garuṭṭhānīyo sabrahmacārī, so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā saddhaṃ paṭilabhati,
ne4:28.2: tattha yā vīmaṃsā ussāhanā tulanā upaparikkhā, ayaṃ sutamayīpaññā,
ne4:28.3: tathā sutena nissayena yā vīmaṃsā tulanā upaparikkhā manasānupekkhanā, ayaṃ cintāmayīpaññā.
ne4:28.4: imāhi dvīhi paññāhi manasikārasampayuttassa yaṃ ñāṇaṃ uppajjati dassanabhūmiyaṃ vā bhāvanābhumiyaṃ vā ayaṃ bhāvanāmayīpaññā.
ne4:29.3: yaṃ parato ca ghosena paccattasamuṭṭhitena ca yonisomanasikārena ñāṇaṃ uppajjati ayaṃ bhāvanāmayīpaññā.
ne4:29.4: yassa imā dve paññā atthi sutamayī cintāmayī ca, ayaṃ ugghaṭitaññū,
ne4:29.5: yassa sutamayī paññā atthi cintāmayī natthi ayaṃ vipañcitaññū.
ne4:29.6: yassa neva sutamayī paññā atthi na cintāmayī, ayaṃ neyyo.
ne4:30.2: cattāri saccāni dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ nirodhaṃ maggaṃ.
ne4:30.3: ādīnavo phalaṃ ca dukkhaṃ, assādo samudayo, nissaraṇaṃ nirodho, upāyo āṇatti ca maggo,
ne4:31.2: “idaṃ dukkhanti me bhikkhave bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appattivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ” (sabbaṃ dhammacakkaṃ.)
ne4:32.1: tattha aparimāṇā padā aparimāṇā akkharā aparimāṇā byañjanā aparimāṇā ākārā neruttā niddesā.
ne4:32.2: etasseva atthassa saṃkāsanā pakāsanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ paññatti itipi’daṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ.
ne4:33.1: “ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti me bhikkhave bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ …pe…
ne4:33.3: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti me bhikkhave bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatane migadāye anuttaraṃ dhammacakkaṃ pavattitaṃ appattivattiyaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ”
ne4:34.1: tattha aparimāṇā padā aparimāṇā akkharā aparimāṇā byañjanā aparimāṇā ākārā neruttā niddesā.
ne4:34.2: etasseva atthassa saṃkāsanā pakāsanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ paññatti itipi’daṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāariyasaccaṃ.
ne4:35.1: tattha bhagavā akkharehi saṅkāseti, padehi pakāseti, byañjanehi vivarati, ākārehi vibhajati, niruttīhi uttānīkaroti, niddesehi paññāpeti.
ne4:35.2: tattha bhagavā akkharehi ca padehi ca ugghāṭeti, byañjanehi ca ākārehi ca vipañcayati, niruttīhi ca niddesehi ca vitthāreti.
ne4:35.3: tattha ugghāṭanā ādi, vipañcanā majjhe, vitthāraṇā pariyosānaṃ.
ne4:35.4: soyaṃ dhammavinayo ugghaṭīyanto ugghaṭitaññupuggalaṃ vineti, tena naṃ āhu ādikalyāṇoti,
ne4:35.5: vipañciyanto vipañcitaññūpuggalaṃ vineti, tena naṃ āhu: majjhekalyāṇoti.
ne4:35.6: vitthārīyanto neyyapuggalaṃ vineti, tena naṃ āhu: pariyosānakalyāṇoti.
ne4:36.1: tattha chappadāni attho: saṃkāsanā pakāsanā vivaraṇā vibhajanā uttānīkammaṃ paññatti. imāni chappadāni attho.
ne4:36.2: chappadāni byañjanaṃ: akkharaṃ padaṃ byañjanaṃ ākāro nirutti niddeso. imāni chappadāni byañjanaṃ.
ne4:36.3: tenāha bhagavā: “dhammaṃ vo bhikkhave desissāmi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjananti”.
ne4:37.3: “parisuddhaṃ”ti nimmalaṃ sabbamalāpagataṃ pariyodātaṃ upaṭṭhitaṃ sabbavisesānaṃ. idaṃ vuccati tathāgatapadaṃ itipi tathāgatanisevitaṃ itipi tathāgatārañjitaṃ itipi. ato cetaṃ brahmacariyaṃ paññāyati.
